content:
Homes for Sale in Bartow, FL

I have helped dozens of families find homes in Bartow, the county seat of Polk County and one of the most affordable markets in the greater Tampa Bay region. Bartow offers historic charm with tree-lined streets, a walkable downtown, and a cost of living well below the state average. My name is Barrett Henry, and I am a licensed Broker Associate with REMAX Collective. Call me at (813) 733-7907.

Homes for Sale in Bartow, Florida

Bartow Market Overview

According to recent MLS data, the median home price in Bartow is approximately $265,000 as of mid-2026, with price per square foot averaging around $165. The market has seen steady appreciation over the past several years, though prices remain significantly lower than comparable communities closer to Tampa. Inventory levels have improved from pandemic-era lows, giving buyers more choices and slightly more negotiating power.

Popular Neighborhoods in Bartow

Bartow has several established neighborhoods that attract buyers at various price points.

  • Highland City - Homes from $250,000 to $400,000, popular with families seeking newer construction
  • Downtown Bartow Historic District - Charming older homes from $180,000 to $350,000 with character and walkability
  • Bartow Estates - Established single-family homes from $220,000 to $380,000
  • Lake Region - Waterfront and water-view properties from $300,000 to $500,000

Schools in Bartow

Bartow is served by Polk County Public Schools, one of the largest school districts in Florida. Notable schools include Bartow High School, which has a long academic and athletic tradition, Bartow Middle School, and several well-regarded elementary schools including Gibbons Street Elementary and Floral Avenue Elementary. Union Academy, a magnet school, offers specialized programs for qualifying students.

What to Know Before Buying in Bartow

Many older homes in Bartow do not have HOA fees, which is a significant cost savings. Flood insurance may be required for properties near Peace River or local lakes. Bartow is approximately 50 miles from downtown Tampa, making it a 55 to 65 minute commute depending on traffic. Lakeland is only 15 minutes north and offers additional shopping, dining, and employment options. Property taxes in Polk County are generally lower than Hillsborough or Pinellas counties.

Why Buyers Choose Bartow

I tell my clients that Bartow is where you get the most house for your money in the greater Tampa area. Unlike newer planned communities, Bartow has genuine history dating back to the 1800s, a real downtown with local restaurants and shops, and large lot sizes that are hard to find closer to the coast. The Bartow Air Base redevelopment has brought new commercial activity, and the city is investing in infrastructure improvements that signal long-term growth.

I tell my clients that Indian Rocks Beach is the beach community that locals choose when they actually want to live at the beach. The height restrictions mean the town has maintained its character while places like Clearwater Beach and Madeira Beach have added high-rise towers. The Crabby Bill's restaurants, the IRB Beach Park, and the Action 2000 nature preserve give the community a family-oriented identity.
